description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class 'InvalidTenantIdentifierExceptionMapper' which maps 'InvalidTenantIdentifierException' to an HTTP response with a 401 Unauthorized status, returning a JSON error response. It is part of the Fineract project and handles specific exception translation for security-related tenant identification errors.

classes.name: InvalidTenantIdentifierExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class implementing ExceptionMapper to handle InvalidTenantIdentifierException and convert it into an appropriate HTTP response.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an InvalidTenantIdentifierException into an HTTP Response with status 401, containing a JSON error message.
